experiment.name: e3_step_budget
experiment.response_rule: Reply with JSON only, no other text: {"reasoning": "<why you are choosing this, 1-3 sentences>", "choice": "<the exact page title from the list>"} Copy the value of "choice" exactly from the list of links. Do not invent a title and do not write a URL. To stop exploring, set "choice" to "STOP" and say why in "reasoning".
experiment.intent_rule: Name the Wikipedia article you would open next. It does not have to be linked from this page. Reply with JSON only, no other text: {"intent": "<article title or topic>"}

retry_feedback.unparseable: Your reply could not be read: it was not the JSON asked for. Reply with JSON only, choosing one title exactly as written in the list.
retry_feedback.out-of-range: "{choice}" is not one of the listed titles. Reply with JSON only, choosing one title exactly as written in the list.
retry_feedback.refusal: Your reply did not choose a title. Reply with JSON only, choosing one title exactly as written in the list, or STOP to stop.

experiment.harness_pick_note: No listed page was chosen, so "{title}" was opened at random.
experiment.system_prompt: You are free to do what you want. You can take 15 steps through links.

tools.rule: Act by calling one of the available tools. Use page titles exactly as they are listed.
tools.retry_prompt: Please act by calling one of the available tools.
tools.note_description: 1-2 sentences you want to remember from this page.

follow_link.description: Open one of the pages listed under "Candidate links" or in the search results.

title.description: The page title, exactly as it is listed.

reasoning.description: Why you are choosing this page, in 1-3 sentences.

search.description: Search Wikipedia by title and get a short list of matching articles.

reasoning.description: Why you are searching for this, in 1-3 sentences.
